title: Bio-enhanced phytotherapeutic formulation comprising Boswellia serrata and Zingiber officinale
text: An oral formulation for cartilage protection comprising standardized boswellic acids enriched in 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA) and gingerols from Zingiber officinale, demonstrating synergistic suppression of 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX) and matrix metalloproteinase-3 (MMP-3).
